name: Súria (Spain)
description: White field with three black chevrons pointing upwards.
history: The flag was approved on 29 November 1991; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, white, with three black chevrons pointing upwards, each 1/6 of the height and separated by 1/12, the first rising from the lower third and the point ending 1/9 from the top; as in the arms (approved 8 May 1990) the three chevrons symbolise the place called Mig-món.

features.role: three chevrons pointing upwards, each 1/6 of the height, separated by 1/12
